title: This Mistake Could Destroy Your Business—And Your Wallet
content: Welcome to Dealmakers. I'm Sarah Sharpe, a deal attorney who helps people buy and sell businesses every day. It is very human to not want to take on an enormous amount of risk all by yourself. And it's incredibly edifying to try to find somebody else who's got a whole different set of skills and talent and interest and connections and say, Hey, why don't you take this risk on with me? You also spread out your reward. So nobody cares enough about the business to do what needs to be done to make it successful. That is the number one thing that I see people do that results in cataclysmic legal costs is they bring in partners before they should have or maybe when they should have just had a hundred percent owned business. The very best use case for business ownership in my view is George Dyson of the Dyson backgames. Dyson is a hundred percent owned by George Dyson. description:
Thinking about adding a partner to your business? Watch this first.

In this video, I share about the one mistake she wishes every business owner would stop making in 2025: giving away equity too soon, too fast, and to the wrong people.

From “business divorces” that drag on for years to rock-climbing ex-partners still collecting checks, I have seen it all—and I'm here to help you avoid the expensive, emotional chaos of bad partnership decisions.

Whether you’re starting a business, buying one, or just feeling pressured to bring someone in to "share the risk," this video will walk you through:

✅ Why 50/50 partnerships almost never work long-term
✅ How partner disputes are like messy divorces (yes, lawyers and all)
✅ Smarter ways to structure relationships without giving away the store
✅ Real alternatives to handing out equity like Starbucks gift cards
✅ And how to protect yourself if you do bring in a co-owner

If you want to grow your business without losing control (or your mind), this one’s for you.

For more information on Deal Academy, a program that teaches you how to buy and sell accounting practices, click the link here:
https://www.dealacademy.org

To connect with Sara Sharp on LinkedIn:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/sara-sharp-9a2a98b/

For more information on our Mergers and Acquisitions law practice click here:
https://www.skandslegal.com
